newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET TO SUPPLY CONTROL SYSTEM TO M-SERLA.
newsitem.headline: VALMET TO SUPPLY CONTROL SYSTEM TO M-SERLA.

text.p: Finnish paper machine group Valmet Oy said in a statement on Friday it would supply a control system for pulp washing to Metsa-Serla's board mill Savon Selly in Kuopio.
"The new washing unit will come into use in March 1997," it said but did not disclose the value of the deal.
The Savon Selly mill currently produces about 230,000 tonnes of fluting board per year, Valmet said.
"Savon Selly aims, through more effective pulp washing, to improve board quality and reduce environmental emissions," it said.
Apart from system hardware, Valmet's delivery would also include applications engineering and start-up, it said.
